subject.title: fix(msteams): stop SharePoint uploads overwriting same-named generated files in Teams

question: Should Microsoft Teams outbound SharePoint uploads treat a repeated filename as a new retained file at the upload boundary, rather than preserve the current replace-in-place behavior?
rationale: The code change fixes the reported stale-card regression, but it intentionally changes the persistence semantics for every same-name outbound upload and source inspection in this review could not prove that no supported update-in-place workflow relies on replacement.

options.title: Adopt rename-on-conflict with tenant proof
options.body: Confirm that the send path is append-like, then require a redacted Teams/SharePoint collision run before merge.

options.title: Preserve replacement behavior
options.body: Keep the current upload contract and pursue a narrower upstream generated-filename uniqueness fix if maintainers want collision avoidance without changing SharePoint upload semantics.

recommendation.title: Adopt rename-on-conflict with tenant proof
recommendation.body: Confirm that the send path is append-like, then require a redacted Teams/SharePoint collision run before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: They supplied the concrete boundary analysis and can clarify the proposed behavior, although current-main ownership remains unverified.
